verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a government filing and search portal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only single-item filing, drafts, per-search fees and a shopping cart. None of it describes performing an operation across many entities, filings or searches at once. A shopping cart for checkout is an adjacent feature, not a documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
